value.title: The Terrifying New School Term! The Mysterious Demon Claw
value.synopsis: A new school term begins; Hiroshi's heart is attacked by a Yōkai, so Nube must save his life.

value.title: Hanako-san of the Toilet Has Appeared!
value.synopsis: Nube, Kyoko and Hiroshi investigate a ghost that appears in the bathroom.

value.title: Cannot Shut Out the Rumors! The Talkative Ghost, the Terrifying Five-tongues!
value.synopsis: A talkative youkai makes everybody hate Miki because of her harsh rumors.

value.title: Prohibited?! Kappa the Water Demon Came Out Under the Tetsubou
value.synopsis: A Kappa tries to stop the horizontal bars being used because there's a bomb.

value.title: The Seven Mysteries in School, the Magical 13 Stairs
value.synopsis: Katsuya meets a troubled boy who makes him cross the 13th step.

value.title: Nube Dead?! Strongest Rival, Youko Tamamo
value.synopsis: A Kitsune, Yoko Tamamo, tries to kill Hiroshi to get his skull and become human. On Nube's attempt to save Hiroshi, Nube ended topless in a blood bath after he falls in a dark warehouse and his torso, arms, and back are slashed by 4 claws.

value.title: Demon Hand VS Fire Circle Tail Technique
value.synopsis: Nube fights Yoko Tamamo to save Hiroshi, despite his injury and blood loss. If Nube attempted to save Hiroshi, it is Hiroshi who will save and takes care of Nube with loving hug as the latter suffers in injury and blood loss.

value.title: UFO Attacks! Aliens Approach on Warabemori City
value.synopsis: Shuichi meets Hiroshi, Kyoko, Miki and Katsuya to witness a UFO.

value.title: Class 5-3 Big Panic! Big Breast 6-feet Neck Woman
value.synopsis: Miki gains the ability to stretch her neck and spy on her friends.

value.title: Outbreak of Devils! Studious Children Be Careful
value.synopsis: Akira is constantly attacked by a demon who ruins his works.

value.title: Scoop! Nube is Married to Yukime!?
value.synopsis: Nube and Yukime meet again after a long time; she tries to freeze him and take him with her to the mountains.

value.title: Terrifying Outing! Mystery of Hell Gate Ridge
value.synopsis: After a picnic, the school bus is attacked by a youkai.

value.title: The Classroom Transforms Into a Lethal Weapon!? Curse of the Demon Blade
value.synopsis: Katsuya steals money from a shrine, now the sword from that temple turns into a youkai trying to kill sinful people, including Katsuya.

value.title: Two Kyoukos!? Doppelganger Terror
value.synopsis: Kyoko's doppelganger flees and Nube must find it before Kyoko dies.

value.title: Yukime Returns! Freezing Mission in Summer
value.synopsis: Yukime returns, but this time, with plans of live as a human, causing problems to Nube, and risking her life at the end trying to save the life of a girl trapped in a fire.

value.title: The Demon Claw Cannot Be Used!! Freak in the Old School Hostel
value.synopsis: In an attempt to save Makoto, Nube ends up possessed by a powerful youkai making impossible for him to use his Oni no te.

value.title: Poolside Romance... Spirit at the 4th Course
value.synopsis: Kyoko gets swimming lessons from the pool ghost.

value.title: Fox Demon, Tamamo, Resurrects! The Mammoth Demon Fish Which Resides in the School Yard!!
value.synopsis: A giant fish youkai attacks the school and Nube and Youko Tamamo become allies to defeat it.

value.title: Continuous Tearing Up! Pursuit of Strongest Love Pair
value.synopsis: Nube and Yukime pursuit a demon who is killing the love pairs in Doumori.

value.title: Time Slip Into the Past! I`d Seen it, Nube`s Secret!!
value.synopsis: Nube travels into the past trying to prevent Minako-sensei's death.

value.title: Clash With the Gods! I Should Receive Punishment!!
value.synopsis: After Katsuya accidentally kills a fish from God's lake, God's messenger tries to kill him as a punishment.

value.title: Someone is Behind You! The Frightening Spiritual Photographs!!
value.synopsis: Portions of a ghost appear in the photos of a trip of the 5-3 students.

value.title: Mystery of 00:00:00!? Parallel Mirrors of the Seven Mysteries
value.synopsis: Kyoko and Miki reflect themselves on opposing mirrors on the school at midnight showing them their older selves, now each time they reflect themselves they see themselves getting more and more old.

value.title: The Devilish D-cup!! The Legend of the Crow`s Love
value.synopsis: Miki use the love crow legend for spend all her time with Hiroshi, causing Kyoko to get jealous.

value.title: The Panic of Happiness! The Zashiki Warashi Who Disappeared Between Tears
The Birth of a Terrifying 2nd Generation!! Mama`s a Demon, Papa`s a Teacher!
value.synopsis: Yukime creates a baby that looks like her and Nube and they must stop Yukibe from wreaking havoc in the city.

value.title: The Dangerous Part-time Job of Spiritualism, Izuna, the Girl Who is Able to Control Spirited Animals
value.synopsis: Izuna has kudakitsunes that can perform almost anything. One day, an evil one is born and she needs Nube's help to stop it.

value.title: Extremely Strange X-mas... the Kesaran-pasaran of Happiness
value.synopsis: Miki finds a Kesalan Patharan and decides to breed them for her own use. While at the mall, she must decide whether to use them all to save Nube, Kyoko, Hiroshi, and Makoto from falling to their death.

value.title: The All-star Demons Appearance! The Cursed School Festival
value.synopsis: Nube's class creates a haunted house for a school festival, but it gets scorned by a young gang group who always love to cause a lot of trouble to Domori's populace. Nube then decides to bring in the real spirits for their enjoyment.

value.title: The Terror After Class! The Running Ninomiya Kinjirou Statue!!
value.synopsis: Makoto begins to be pursued by the Ninomia Kinjirou statue after he accidentally rips an ancient book.

value.title: The Terror of the Eye-ball Demon Which Cannot be Told to Anyone!! The Crime of the Violinist Prodigy
value.synopsis: Ai Shinozaki, a great violinist at Doumori begins to have eyeballs appearing on her body because she steals. She must decide to confess or be overtaken by the demon.

value.title: And Then Everyone Starts to Disappear! The Mysterious Red-clothed Girl in the Library!!
value.synopsis: A girl's spirit begins attacking the students of 5-3 because of a missing book that used to be her favorite.

value.title: Appears Shoukera on the Window! Ritsuko-sensei`s Maximum Crisis
value.synopsis: Mamoru Kazama, a student of Ritsuko-sensei's class is sent to the hospital after he sees a dancing demon on top of his house. Ritsuko-sensei feels she must protect him and stays with him in the face of danger.

value.title: The Past of the Interdiction Which is Now Revealed! The Secret of the Birth of the Demon`s Claw!!
value.synopsis: One day, Nube's demon hand begins to overtake his body and Tamamo, Hiroshi, and Kyoko must travel to the past to find the solution before Nube becomes an Oni.

value.title: Daidarabochi is My Cautive! Miki-chan`s Dream Town!!
value.synopsis: Miki realizes one day that buildings are being moved after she says where she wants them. No one else notices because they are already "accustomed" to the new arrangement. She ends up wishing Domori Elementary away and it's up to her to save the school.

value.title: The Midnight Secret Lesson! The Dangerous Allurement of the Music Room!!
value.synopsis: Kyoko bets with Miki that she will learn to play the piano in one week. Kyoko ends up going to secret midnight lessons thinking it's a dream. Her weariness begins to show and it concerns Miki and Nube.

value.title: The Things I Left Behind 20 Years Ago!? The Blood-stained Notebook!!
value.synopsis: Makoto stumbles upon a 20-year-old agenda once owned by a student who forgot everything. The student ends up drowning and the spirit comes back to help Makoto. Shortly, the spirit begins to try to kill Makoto and have him discover his body.

value.title: Eh! Rival`s First Date? Yukime`s Long and Hot Day!!
value.synopsis: Yukime upsets Zashiki Warashi, so the Zashiki Warashi brings good luck to Nube by having Ritsuko-sensei ask Nube on a date and making Yukime jealous.

value.title: Vengeance from the Abyss of Death! Has It Come Out? The Secret of the Union Between the Demon and the Fox Spirit!
value.synopsis: Shuichi's turtle that went down the drain comes back as a monster that Tamamo thinks will be satisfied if Shuichi is sacrificed.

value.title: The Sailor Suit Burns! Unable to Hide Emotions of the Heart!!
value.synopsis: Izuna begins to spontaneously burst into fire at random times. She must relieve her stress that has built up or else she will perish.

value.title: Want to Become Friends... The Mysterious Classmate, the Melodic Consciousness
value.synopsis: A model of the human body in a science class inherits a spirit and doesn't realize that he isn't an human being. He wants to become friends with Nube's classmates, but they are terrified of him.

value.title: My Mother is a 4-year Old Child?! The Memory of the Previous Life
value.synopsis: Hiroshi's mother is reincarnated as a 4-year-old school girl to see him, but Hiroshi doesn't believe it. She was reincarnated for Hiroshi to know the situation before she died.

value.title: Yukime Dies!! Love Disappears with the Snow Crystal...
value.synopsis: Yukime is fooled into thinking that taking a human's soul will turn her into a human. Yukime targets Ritsuko-sensei because Yukime wants to have a relationship with Nube.

value.title: Not Recommended for Kids, the Prohibited Hundred Ghost Stories
value.synopsis: A demon takes on the form of Nube and orders every student in the class to tell their scariest stories to aid in opening the portal to the spirit world.

value.title: Dream? Fantasy? The Revival of My Sweetheart Yukime, Why do You Want to Take My Life!!
The Heroines Who were Attacked! The Exciting Bathroom Panic!!
The Strongest! The Biggest! The Last Enemy, the Name is... the God of Poverty!!
value.synopsis: The God of Poverty targets Nube and makes his money vanish so he becomes poor. What both of them don't realize is that everyone that knows Nube loves and cares for him.

value.title: Forever Dream!! Our Favourite Nube!
value.synopsis: Kyoko wakes up one day just to discover that she already becomes a mature woman and her life becomes entirely different than how it should be..

value.title: Complete Unedited Edition!! Hell Teacher Nube`s Super Encyclopedia
value.synopsis: A collection/recap of all the episodes (an encyclopedia of demons, spirits, the story of the Oni no te, the romances, etc.)
